entries.reason: No retained analysis across updates (ADR 0364): every edit recomputes the demanded files, so the generated 1000-file one-file edit is ~4x the Go producer that still retained answers. Applies only while the merge base is a Go-era commit; once the switch (ADR 0365) is the base, the default limit applies again.

The incremental Reactive IR's per-entry bookkeeping on a cold build (ADR 03XX-cold-cost): the generated 1000-file corpus's first IR is ~1.19x the pre-memo IR on 14 cores and ~1.32-1.35x on four (CI), traded for 3-9x faster edits on real projects (whose first IR is faster than before). Applies only while the merge base's IR keeps no memo tables (`baseIr: fresh`); once the memo store is on main, the default limit applies again.
